definitions.purchases: Distinct Transaction ID within branch, never row count
definitions.cogs: Sum quantity * unit cost; verified equals revenue - gross profit
definitions.standardized_gap: Garden quantity * (Garden unit cost - peer unit cost), product by product
definitions.raw_gap: Garden COGS - peer COGS = standardized gap + (Garden quantity - peer quantity) * peer cost
definitions.rounding: Direct: [target-.005, target+.005) / recorded peer. Both-rounded: ((target-.005)/(peer+.005), (target+.005)/(peer-.005)). Positive values; half-up convention. Shared-factor tests avoid ties.
definitions.duplicates: Primary retains all rows; exact rows once is unproven sensitivity; txn/product first and last are deliberately aggressive stress tests.

cost_rules.model: multiply recorded peer cost then round
